story.titleZh: 墨西哥站一练11队换将，车手市场暗流涌动
story.summaryZh: 墨西哥大奖赛第一节练习中，11支F1车队里有10支将派出仅参加该节的年轻车手，其中三人的安排对车手市场影响尤为关键。法拉利是唯一不调整车手阵容的车队。
story.originalTitle: Three Mexico FP1 changes with high driver market stakes
story.summaryEn: In Mexico FP1, 10 of the 11 Formula 1 teams will field a rookie driver for that session only, with three of those changes carrying particularly high stakes for the driver market. Ferrari is the only team not changing its driver line-up.
detailZh: 11支F1车队中有10支将在墨西哥派出仅参加第一节练习的年轻车手，但其中一些调整对F1车手市场影响尤为重大。
法拉利是唯一不调整车手阵容的车队。以下是其他车队换人的完整名单，其中包括三人的F1比赛周末首秀（加布里埃莱·米尼、尼古拉·措洛夫和弗雷迪·斯莱特）。
迈凯伦：莱昂纳多·福尔纳罗利顶替兰多·诺里斯
红牛：岩佐步梦顶替马克斯·维斯塔潘
梅赛德斯：弗雷德里克·维斯蒂顶替乔治·拉塞尔
阿尔派：加布里埃莱·米尼顶替弗兰科·科拉平托
小红牛：尼古拉·措洛夫顶替利亚姆·劳森
奥迪：弗雷迪·斯莱特顶替加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托
阿斯顿·马丁：杰克·克劳福德替换兰斯·斯特罗尔
凯迪拉克：科尔顿·赫塔替换瓦尔特利·博塔斯
其中有一些熟悉的第一次练习赛名字，他们已经在2026年驾驶过，但墨西哥站可能是本赛季最有趣的阵容，尤其有三个名字在F1车手市场意义上格外突出……
赫塔的多年任务完成了吗？
凯迪拉克认为，科尔顿·赫塔现在只差一分就能最终拿到他成功申请F1超级驾照所需的40分。
前提是他周五从瓦尔特利·博塔斯手中接过凯迪拉克赛车后，能在第一节练习中顺利完成规定的100公里行驶里程。
鉴于墨西哥的条件十分艰苦，加上F1新军凯迪拉克遭遇的各种可靠性问题，这一点并无保证。
但即便他没能完成那100公里，凯迪拉克也会确保他在别处补上最后一分。车队已经满足了新秀车手规则；他们之所以让赫塔在墨西哥参加第一节练习，只是为了确保他能达到40分。
这样一来，只要车队认为他是最合适的车手，赫塔就能正式成为2027年替代博塔斯的选项。
佩雷斯谈到赫塔时说：“跑一练总是很难展示你的速度或你所在的水平，但现在我认为他在车里和模拟器里有了更多时间，所以我们开始看到更多他的速度。”
“这不是我的决定，但我认为这将由马钦（布德科夫斯基，凯迪拉克车队老板）来决定他们想要谁坐进车里。”
“我和瓦尔特利也合作得很好。我认为他在几场比赛中非常不走运。在奥斯汀，他展现了非常强劲的速度，所以对车队来说没有轻松的决定。”
佩雷斯补充说，“接下来的三到四个月在我们的准备工作中非常关键”，因此拥有合适的车手将很重要。
角田裕毅和梅赛德斯替补车手弗雷德里克·维斯蒂——在同一节第一次自由练习中替代乔治·拉塞尔——也是凯迪拉克的候选人之一，车队尚未做出最终决定。
这就是为什么赫塔在第一次自由练习中表现强劲如此重要。正是在墨西哥，奥利·贝尔曼（哈斯）和伊萨克·哈贾尔（小红牛）给他们的未来车队留下了如此强烈的第一印象。
这不能仅凭头条圈速来判断，而要看车手如何在紧凑的时间框架内勤勉地执行运行计划。
赫塔迄今为止在第一节自由练习中的表现给车队留下了深刻印象，但随着凯迪拉克2027年车手决定的临近，这一次他承受着迄今为止最大的压力。
红牛的下一位F1车手？
F2锦标赛竞争者尼古拉·措洛夫正随小红牛迎来自己的F1比赛周末首秀，他此前已于8月底在伊莫拉首次测试F1赛车。
曾有传言称，措洛夫在其F2赛季巅峰期有望于2027年全职获得小红牛的那个席位，当时他在四个周末内赢下了四场比赛。
现在看来这似乎不太可能，因为这意味着要让利亚姆·劳森或阿尔维德·林德布拉德让位，而两人目前都表现强劲。
劳森是积分榜前四车队之外表现最好的车手，并且连续三个比赛周末赢下了中游集团的争夺。
林德布拉德与劳森并肩作战，新秀赛季表现稳健，因此措洛夫可能要等到2028年才有机会。
不过，现在在墨西哥给人留下深刻印象对措洛夫来说很重要。前面提到的哈贾尔在2023年墨西哥站第一节练习赛的强劲表现，是在他被确认为小红牛F1车手之前的14个月。
措洛夫是下一个有望获得F1席位的车手，但如果在得到机会时不能给人留下深刻印象，就很容易在排队中被别人超越。
而且考虑到F2是如此难以解读的系列赛，尽管措洛夫今年表现令人印象深刻——他一直与2027年哈斯F1车手拉斐尔·卡马拉实力相当——但如果你无法在F1赛车中转化这种表现，那就毫无意义。
奥迪的首位F1青训车手弗雷迪·斯莱特将在墨西哥和巴西连续参加两场第一节自由练习赛，开启他的F1赛车生涯。
这位18岁的车手在蒙扎正赛因机械故障以及马德里噩梦般的收官周末，以微弱劣势错失了今年的F3冠军。
但那是在一个赛季的尾声，他在连续八个比赛周末都登上领奖台，印证了他在卡丁车之后连夺三个冠军头衔所展现的潜力——吉内塔青少年系列赛、意大利四级方程式和欧洲区域方程式锦标赛。
奥迪签下斯莱特对其初生的F1车手培养计划而言是一次重大胜利，此前他们击退了竞争对手强烈而持续的追逐。
与措洛夫和赫塔等人相比，斯莱特面临的“即刻出成绩”压力要小一些，他将有机会通过背靠背的各节练习与排位逐步积累，但对斯莱特依然有很高的期待。
他并不是2027年F1席位的竞争者，因为明年他将随卫冕系列赛冠军Invicta参加二级方程式，但可以预见在未来几个赛季里，斯莱特会更多地出现在F1赛车中。
detailEn: All but one of the 11 Formula 1 teams will be fielding an FP1-only rookie in Mexico, but some of those changes have particularly high stakes for F1's driver market.

Ferrari is the only team not making a change to its driver line-up. Here's the full list of the swaps elsewhere, including three F1 weekend debuts (for Gabriele Mini, Nikola Tsolov and Freddie Slater).
McLaren: Leonardo Fornaroli for Lando Norris
Red Bull: Ayumu Iwasa for Max Verstappen
Mercedes: Frederik Vesti for George Russell
Alpine: Gabriele Mini for Franco Colapinto
Racing Bulls: Nikola Tsolov for Liam Lawson
Audi: Freddie Slater for Gabriel Bortoleto
Aston Martin: Jak Crawford for Lance Stroll
Cadillac: Colton Herta for Valtteri Bottas

There are some familiar FP1 names there who have already driven in 2026, but Mexico is probably the most interesting roster of the season, with three names in particular standing out as significant in F1 driver market terms…
Herta's multi-year mission complete?
Cadillac believes Colton Herta is now just one point away from finally earning the 40 he needs to successfully apply for an F1 superlicence.
That's if he can successfully complete the mandated 100 kilometres of running in FP1 when he takes over Valtteri Bottas's Cadillac on Friday.
There's no guarantee of that given how tough the conditions are in Mexico and the various reliability issues F1 newcomer Cadillac has encountered.

But even if he doesn't get that 100km, Cadillac will ensure he ticks off that last point somewhere else. The team has already satisfied the rookie driver rule; it's only putting Herta in the car for FP1 in Mexico to make sure he gets to the 40 points.
That's all so Herta can officially be an option to replace Bottas for 2027 should the team decide he's the best driver for the job.

"Doing FP1s is always very difficult to show your speed or the level you're at, but now I think he's having more time in the car and in the simulator, so we're starting to see more of his speed," Perez said of Herta.
"It's not my decision, but I think it will be down to Marcin [Budkowski, Cadillac team boss] to decide who they want in the car.
"I'm also working really well with Valtteri. I think he's been very unfortunate in a few races. In Austin, he showed very strong pace, so there isn't an easy decision for the team."
Perez added that "the next three or four months are really crucial in our preparation" and thus having the right drivers will be important.
Yuki Tsunoda and Mercedes reserve driver Frederik Vesti - replacing George Russell in the same FP1 session - are also among the Cadillac contenders, with the team yet to make a final decision.

That's why Herta performing strongly in FP1 is so important. It was in Mexico that both Ollie Bearman (Haas) and Isack Hadjar (Racing Bulls) made such strong first impressions with their future teams.
That can't be judged by headline laptime alone, but by how the driver diligently delivers a runplan in a compact timeframe.
Herta has impressed the team in his FP1 outings so far, but this one carries the greatest pressure so far as Cadillac's 2027 driver decision looms.
Red Bull's next F1 driver?
Formula 2 championship contender Nikola Tsolov is making his F1 weekend debut with Racing Bulls, having first tested an F1 car at Imola in late August.
There were whispers of Tsolov earning that Racing Bulls seat full-time for 2027 amid the peak of his F2 season, where he won four races in four weekends.
That would seem a long shot now, as it would mean moving Liam Lawson or Arvid Lindblad aside when both are performing strongly.
Lawson is the clear best-of-the-rest driver behind those in the top four teams in the points standings and has won the midfield fight three weekends in a row.
Lindblad has had a solid rookie year alongside Lawson, so Tsolov may need to wait until 2028 for his chance.
Impressing now in Mexico will be important, though, for Tsolov. The aforementioned strong Hadjar Mexico 2023 FP1 came 14 months before he was confirmed as a Racing Bulls F1 driver.
Tsolov is next in line for an F1 seat, but it's very easy to be jumped in that queue if you don't impress when given the opportunity.

And given F2 is such a hard series to read, as impressive as Tsolov has been this year - he's been a worthy match for 2027 Haas F1 driver Rafael Camara - it means nothing if you can't translate that performance when in an F1 car.
Audi's first F1 junior Freddie Slater has back-to-back FP1 outings in Mexico and Brazil to kick off his time in an F1 car.
The 18-year-old narrowly missed out on this year's Formula 3 title after a mechanical failure in the Monza feature race and a nightmare finale weekend in Madrid.

But that came at the end of a season where he finished on the podium in eight consecutive weekends, backing up the potential he showed by winning three consecutive titles out of karting - Ginetta Juniors, Italian Formula 4 and the Formula Regional European Championship.
Audi signing Slater was a huge coup for its fledgling F1 driver development scheme, it having fought off strong and persistent interest from rivals.

There's less of a ‘perform now' pressure on Slater than the likes of Tsolov and Herta, and he'll have the chance to build up through his back-to-back sessions, but there's still plenty of expectation on Slater.

He's not a contender for a 2027 F1 seat as he'll be racing in Formula 2 next year with defending series champion Invicta, but you can expect to see a lot more of Slater in an F1 car over the next few seasons.

迈凯伦由莱昂纳多·福尔纳罗利顶替兰多·诺里斯参加一练。
红牛由岩佐步梦顶替马克斯·维斯塔潘参加一练。
keyPointsEn: Gabriele Mini, Nikola Tsolov and Freddie Slater will make their F1 weekend debuts in Mexico.
McLaren will field Leonardo Fornaroli in place of Lando Norris in FP1.
Red Bull will field Ayumu Iwasa in place of Max Verstappen in FP1.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
